breakdown.description: An n-type semiconductor with large donor density should have electrons as the majority carriers, not holes.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that in an n-type semiconductor with ND = 1.0×10^22 m^-3, electrons must be the majority carriers (n ≈ ND ≈ 1×10^22 m^-3), and holes must be the minority carriers (p ≈ 1×10^10 m^-3). It explicitly states that the listed values imply p ≫ n, which would indicate p-type behavior, directly contradicting the n-type description. This aligns with the ground truth's intent to qualitatively assess carrier concentrations without accepting the flawed listed values.
